review_scope: Review the frozen 12 proposed measured GPT-6 Luna ARC-AGI-1 and ARC-AGI-2 observations and canonical reasoning-effort identity mappings before registry publication.
acceptance_criteria: Verify the included ARC Prize results page evidence shows the GPT-6 Luna title, an ARC Prize Verified badge, and publication date 2026-09-22.
Check each of the 12 values, benchmark assignments, source variant labels, percent units, measured basis, and publication dates directly against the included ARC page excerpt.

Check the 12 model IDs against the included OpenAI API model catalog excerpt: API model gpt-6-luna supports none, low, medium, high, xhigh, max; source None maps to API effort none and canonical non-reasoning.
Confirm coverage is exactly ARC-AGI-1 and ARC-AGI-2 × Max, XHigh, High, Medium, Low, None, each once; identify any unsupported ARC-AGI-3 row or other extra claim.
Check that protocol wording describes only what the supplied ARC page excerpt supports.

Return pass only if all 12 rows are supported by supplied primary-source evidence and there is no material uncertainty or missing evidence; otherwise return revise or blocked with exact row locations.
round_2_context: The first critic pass confirmed all 12 values and identity mappings and raised only a non-material concern that prior protocol wording called the table itself “Verified scores.” The protocol text was corrected to describe the visible ARC Prize Verified badge and per-variant table without that unsupported label. Independently verify the revised frozen artifact.

GPT-6 Luna

OpenAI·Sep 22, 2026·12 harness configurations

GPT-6 Luna's best Semi-Private scores are 86.7% on v1 and 59.3% on v2, both at max reasoning. On v3, it reaches 0.2% with the Standard harnessStandard harness enables a model to carry forward notes it chooses to keep with it throughout the environment. at medium reasoning and 0.6% with the Provider Adapter harnessThe Provider Adapter harness preserves opaque reasoning state between requests and uses compaction for longer conversations, allowing the model to reuse prior work. at max reasoning.
